messages:
Maya (Docs): quick PR to reword audit export docs and add examples for tenant-scoped exports. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/780
Omar (Security): please avoid 'tenant email' wording. recommend 'tenant identifier (non-reversible pseudonym)'. also call out that sensitive request fields are redacted in exports.
Ben (Eng): updated python snippet to use export_rows(..., tenant_identifier=...)
Ben (Eng): python: from redwood.audit import AuditClient
client = AuditClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
for r in client.export_rows(scope="tenant", tenant_identifier="nrp-9", format="jsonl"):
  print(r)
Maya (Docs): adding a short curl example as well
Ben (Eng): curl: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" "https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/audit/exports?scope=tenant&tenant_identifier=nrp-9" -o export.jsonl
Clara (Legal): wording ok; please add retention sentence: 'Exports are subject to configured retention periods unless placed on legal hold.'
Omar (Security): add link to redaction docs: /docs/security/log-redaction
DocsBot: CI passed for PR #780 ✅
Maya (Docs): thanks all — I'll merge after a quick CI re-run.
